title: Google Workspace Day-2 Administration & Operations Runbook (OU Design, Policy Governance & Runbooks)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace administration/governance/compliance).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Regulatory/compliance INTERPRETATION (CMMC assessment outcomes, NIST 800-171 applicability, ITAR/DFARS determinations, C3PAO assessment scheduling) is deferred to the organization's compliance/legal/assessor — the solution provides the technical control mapping, configuration method, and evidence, not the certification determination. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Take over Google Workspace operations the day the project goes live
problem: When a Google Workspace project goes live, someone has to run it — and without a structured operations model, day-2 becomes firefighting. This solution is the Day-2 administration & operations runbook: the organizational-unit (OU) design and configuration-policy governance that structures the tenant, plus the steady-state operating model — routine admin SOPs, health checks, monitoring/alerting, request and incident handling, change control, and config-drift detection — so operations are owned, repeatable, and auditable from go-live onward.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the operations model + the OU/policy-governance architecture (OU tree, policy inheritance, settings baseline, change control) and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, admin-role delegation model, monitoring targets, change-control process).

Implementation Guide — design the OU tree + policy inheritance and settings baseline, establish admin-role delegation, stand up monitoring/alerting + health checks, and codify the runbooks (routine SOPs, request/incident handling, change control, config-drift detection) — each artifact named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or operations helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health or control check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Runbook Library + validation gates (OU/policies applied, monitoring live, runbooks exercised) plus Best Practices for a durable day-2 operations practice.
short: Own Google Workspace day-2 operations from go-live — OU design + configuration-policy governance, admin-role delegation, monitoring/health checks, and a runbook library (SOPs, request/incident handling, change control, drift detection) — so operations are repeatable and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Own Google Workspace day-2 operations from go-live — OU design + configuration-policy governance, admin-role delegation, monitoring/health checks, and a runbook library (SOPs, request/incident handling, change control, drift detection) — so operations are repeatable and auditable.
